desc: Implement a safe prefix-count routine `countUpTo(x)` with tight and started states, excluding the all-leading-zero number.
Count numbers with at least one actual zero separately, ensuring leading zero padding is not considered an actual zero.
Count zero-free numbers by enumerating target digit sums and tracking remaining sum plus product modulo that target.
Prune memoized DP states using feasible remaining digit-sum bounds.
Verify examples and edge cases including single digits, powers of ten, and bounds of differing digit lengths.
